Question Choices: A pie is cut into 2 equal pieces. How many pieces make the whole pie?
Solution: The pie is cut into two equal halves. Both pieces together make the whole, so 2 pieces are needed.

Question Choices: A rectangle is divided into 4 equal parts. How many equal parts are there?
Solution: The rectangle is stated to have 4 equal parts, so there are 4.

Question Choices: Select. A square is folded into 2 equal parts. Each part is called a: ~~half | third | fourth~~
Solution: Two equal parts are halves. Each part is one half of the square.

Question Choices: Select. Leo shares a sandwich equally with 2 friends, so it is cut into 3 equal pieces. What portion does each person get?: ~~half | third | fourth | whole~~
Hints: 3 equal pieces means each piece is one third.
Solution: Leo and two friends make three people. Three equal pieces give each person one third of the sandwich.

Question Choices: Select True or False. A rectangle cut into 4 parts of different sizes is divided into fourths.: ~~True | False~~
